answer: A kernel of verified work, not capital, lifts an identity toward the zenith tier. Each promotion needs a countersignature from a party outside the applicant's cluster and is escrowed for as many epochs as its rung index, so climbing n aliases burns a quadratic bond that stays locked and unusable. A falcon audit re-runs a random promotion each epoch; a failed replay voids that rung and every identity sharing its countersigner. Bonds are per rung and never transferable, so a coalition cannot pool one escrow across heads or sell standing.
